svg.aria-label: Milliseconds for one user vector search over 2,000 memories of 1,536 dimensions, exact cosine, log scale. PostgreSQL with pgvector in the database: 8.7 ms. D1 with rows sent to the Worker and scored in JavaScript: 85 ms, 2,000 rows read and 29 MB moved. D1 SQL with the query vector in a keyed table: 239 ms, 6.1 million rows read and 3,072 rows written. D1 SQL with jsonb_extract per element: 5.6 s, 3.1 million rows read. D1 SQL with a json_each join: 110 s, about 4.7 billion rows read, past the 30 second D1 query limit.
